def test_triples_sum_to_zero():
    # Triple exists
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 3, -2, 1]) == True   # 1 + (-2) + 1 = 0
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 2, -3, 4]) == True   # 1 + 2 + (-3) = 0
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([0, 0, 0]) == True       # 0 + 0 + 0 = 0
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, -1, 0]) == True      # 1 + (-1) + 0 = 0
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([-1, -2, 3]) == True     # -1 + (-2) + 3 = 0
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([3, -1, -2]) == True     # unsorted input
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([2, 2, -4]) == True      # duplicate values, distinct indices

    # No triple sums to zero
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 3, 5, 0]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 2, 3, 7]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, 1, 1]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([5, 5, 5]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([0, 0, 1]) == False

    # Fewer than three elements
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1]) == False
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([1, -1]) == False

    # Larger lists
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([2, 4, -5, 3, 9, 7]) == True   # 2 + (-5) + 3 = 0
    assert triples_sum_to_zero([10, 20, 30, 40, 50]) == False
